theorem commonSolve_periodic (κ : Plane → ℝ) (p : P) (hp : PeriodicAt d.source p)
    (Y : Plane) (n : Frequency) :
    d.commonSolve g hab κ (p, Y + TorusAverages.latticePoint n) =
      d.commonSolve g hab κ (p, Y)
